name: @561-group/web-taxonomy
description: Tags, categories and author archives as a Chu space over the four-valued bilattice: a taxonomy IS the relation terms × subjects → FOUR. A subject is in a term's extension iff it affirms that taxonomy cell; a contested membership settles to ⊤ (shown, not silently dropped). extension(term) is the archive member set; the transpose gives a subject's terms; relatedness is shared-term overlap. Built on @561-group/math/chu + @561-group/semantic-hypertext; archive member lists compose straight into engine Pages.
